verdict.rationale: kitty's official shell-integration docs say its zsh, fish and bash integration enables jumping to previous prompts in the scrollback and viewing the last command's output in less, which shows it marks prompts and command output. The ssh kitten also sets up shell integration automatically on remote hosts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of jumping forward to the next prompt and of the mappable actions/keybindings for prompt navigation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the feature.
